title: World Bloom — Turning Pain Into Drive — Episode11 Running Toward Our Dream

meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD check in on the tree growing in the plaza of their SEKAI. Suddenly, each of them is thrown into a dream showing them a different life, in a world where their paths diverged...

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone! Are you all okay?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What happened...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank goodness! You guys are finally back to normal!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...happened to us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You were all completely unresponsive for quite some time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it was as if your minds were somewhere else entirely...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We tried to get you all to snap out of it, but nothing we did seemed to work.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Can you tell us what you remember?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So...
I remember us talking about how there was something wrong with the tree in the plaza...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and we were discussing how we could remove all those black fragments.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We were worried that it'd keep getting sicker...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Look over there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The tree's even bigger now...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. And those fragments have all changed color...
se_event_wl_2nd_street_2025_001

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They vanished...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The tree just seemed to absorb all of them at once.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, the leaves look so full of life now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What do you think happened...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think those black flecks were all fragments of feelings.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you see something after you touched them?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I was...dreaming.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And it felt so real. But it was like a different reality...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Different? In what way?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... How should we explain it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well...
In my case...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So it was a dream about how your lives would've turned out if you'd all made different choices.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What's wrong, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I feel kinda sad now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Imagine if they all really became separated and never saw each other ever again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was all just a dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Fortunately, we were somehow able to reunite with one another in the end.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Based on what you all just told us...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your feelings may've created those black fragments.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Our feelings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes. Pain, doubt, internal conflict...
Those are all just as much a part of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They must've been lingering within SEKAI all this time. And they found their way onto the tree.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, then... The tree became “sick” because of our feelings?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was all our fault...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Like Miku just said, those negative emotions are all a part of who you are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, and you all found a way to turn them into something beautiful in the end!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which means you all provided the tree with the nutrients it required to keep growing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
When you put it that way, I suppose it wasn't all bad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, it's normal to experience some pain while trying desperately to reach the top.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... I'm kinda happy that happened, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're happy...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I know that dream was full of not-so-nice things...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we managed to overcome those hurdles and sing as a team again, remember?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, doesn't that mean we'll be able to handle anything that comes our way?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I believe that you'll be able to overcome any obstacles that you encounter and propel yourself to new heights.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you'll likely grow a staggering amount with each passing challenge.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're not gonna stop until we stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. And we'll need to take on everything that comes our way if we want to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we've already overcome a lot until now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, let's keep charging ahead... Together!
